description: Enable Demand-Controlled Ventilation (DCV) with return-air CO2 sensing on all five middle floor (M.*) packaged single-zone HVAC systems in the 4StoreyBuilding eQUEST model. For each of the systems (M.S16, M.E17, M.N18, M.W19, M.C20), change the Minimum Outside Air Method (MIN-OA-METHOD) to 'DCV-RETURN-SENSOR' and set the Indoor CO2 Concentration Limit to 1000 ppm. After applying these settings to all five systems, run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation and save the project.
